parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>instance ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product to delete. A ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the ProductKey in the IoT Platform console or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to view the information about all products under the current account.
